name: prompt-rewrite
description: /rewrite: turns a rough draft prompt into a thorough one, asking clarifying questions first, without adding anything to the conversation

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: Model for /rewrite: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id. Empty: the session's model, sharing its prompt cache.

effort.title: Rewrite effort
effort.description: Effort for the rewrite model above; default leaves the model's own. The session's model keeps the session's effort.

instructions.title: Rewrite instructions
instructions.description: Your instructions for the rewrite prompt, in every project. /rewrite-settings global <text> edits them on several lines.

instructions_mode.title: Rewrite instructions mode
instructions_mode.description: append adds your instructions to the default rewrite rules, replace swaps the rules for them. A project's mode wins.
